svg.title: Where the money goes in the report
svg.desc: Every payment of this school is checked. Pending, failed or deleted payments are left out. A successful payment goes into total collected, a reversal goes into reversed. Net collected is the total minus reversed. Cash paid out from wallets is shown on the side and is not taken off the net.
